title: PTP: Adding 802.1AS-2020 1-step Sync support
description:
This patch adds support for 802.1AS-2020 Sync with 1-step as they carry the originTimestamp and the Follow_UP TLV.

This patch also corrects that 802.1AS Sync with 2-step DO NOT have the originTimestamp but "reserved" data.

Based on https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2638
